svg.text: Redesign: the screen and LED always show what JARVIS is doing.

g.text: LED: solid on = your turn to talk
A chime is easy to miss in a noisy kitchen, so the screen
and a solid-on LED also show JARVIS is listening.
Live level bars show the mic can hear the user.
"Take a memo… email my professor about the
LED: brightness follows the user's voice = recording
While recording, the LED pulses with the user's voice
and the screen shows a timer plus the words as they
are transcribed, so the user knows it is capturing.
LED: slow blink (1 per second) = still listening
From Part E: people add details after a long pause.
After 1.5s of silence JARVIS shows a 3s countdown and
blinks slowly. Speaking again keeps the memo going.
LED: fast blink (4 per second) = working on it
A fast blink and a spinner mean “working on it”,
so the user waits instead of repeating the memo.
"Memo: ‘Email my professor about the Lab 3 extension
before Friday, and attach the form.’ Save it, sir?"
LED: solid on = your turn to answer
JARVIS reads the memo aloud and shows it on screen,
with the three possible answers, so the user knows
LED: 2 long flashes = saved, then dim breathing = idle
Two long flashes confirm the save. Then JARVIS goes
back to idle: a dim, slowly “breathing” LED shows
it is on and ready for the next memo.

svg.text: Status key: what the LED and screen show in each state
LED: SparkFun Qwiic Button, single green, dimmable. Solid = your turn · blinking = JARVIS is busy.
